h1: Just Better Painting vs. Precision Paint Experts
heroIntro: Two exterior bids on the same house rarely describe the same job. Here is a practical way to lay them next to each other and see what each one actually covers.

sections.h2: Start with the job, not the bottom line
body: Just Better Painting is one of the painting companies homeowners across North Central Florida may be weighing alongside Precision Paint Experts. We are not going to describe anyone else's work. What we can offer is a method: a way to put any two exterior quotes on the table and find out whether they are pricing the same house.

The total at the bottom of a bid is the least informative number on it. Before you compare totals, make sure both proposals describe the same surfaces, the same preparation, and the same coating system. If one quote covers the fascia, soffits, and garage door and the other does not, the cheaper one is simply a smaller job.

sections.h2: A line-by-line worksheet for exterior quotes
body: Draw two columns and fill in each row from the paperwork, not from the sales conversation. Anything you cannot find in writing gets a question mark.
bullets: Surfaces included and excluded: siding, trim, doors, shutters, soffits, gutters, railings, porch ceilings.
Washing method and whether mildew treatment is part of it.
Scraping, sanding, caulking, and spot-priming: listed as steps or assumed?
Wood rot and fascia replacement: how it is identified and approved.
Primer and topcoat by product name, and the number of coats.
Start window, expected working days, and dry time.
Warranty length and what it covers, in writing.

sections.h2: How our estimate fills in those rows
body: A crew lead from Precision Paint Experts, not a salesperson, walks the house, measures, photographs conditions, and takes moisture readings where the siding or trim calls for it. The written, itemized estimate usually follows within one business day of that walkthrough.

Every row on the worksheet above has an answer on our paperwork: surfaces in and out, the prep steps, the primer and topcoat product line, the coat count, and the schedule. Our baseline is two full coats, with a third on dramatic color changes or porous surfaces, and sprayed areas are back-brushed or back-rolled where penetration matters. Nothing is added later without your written approval.

sections.h2: The rows that usually explain a price gap
body: When two bids differ sharply, the answer is almost always in preparation. A proper wash and mildew treatment, re-caulking, and spot-priming take real crew time, and they decide how long the finish holds up in this climate. Our guide on how long exterior paint lasts in Florida walks through why.

Product is the second row to check. We use premium Sherwin-Williams and Benjamin Moore lines, with 100% acrylic on siding and trim and elastomeric on stucco with hairline movement, and the specific line is named on the estimate so you can look it up yourself.

sections.h2: Put a written bid next to the one you have
body: If you already hold a quote, a second written scope makes the worksheet easy to finish. Our estimates are free with no obligation, walkthroughs are usually scheduled within 48 hours, and most exterior painting projects start one to three weeks after approval. Behind the work sits a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years on exterior projects, on top of the manufacturer's product warranty. Request your free estimate and compare the rows for yourself.

faqs.q: Is it fair to ask a painter to break out prep work separately?
faqs.a: Yes. Prep is where most of the labor goes, so asking for it to be listed as separate steps is reasonable with any contractor. Our estimates list washing, scraping, sanding, caulking, repairs, and spot-priming as part of the written scope.

faqs.q: What if two quotes name different paint brands?
faqs.a: Compare the specific product lines and coat counts rather than the brand names alone. We name the exact Sherwin-Williams or Benjamin Moore line on our estimate so you can check its specifications.

faqs.q: How long does a full exterior repaint take?
faqs.a: A full exterior usually takes three to seven working days, plus time for washing and drying. The schedule is written on the estimate.
